text: Earlier verdicts compared K4's climbed reading with the copies' by a letter-statistics score, which is poor at damaged English. The judge reads for words and tolerates X stops and misspellings.
Six frozen searches rerun with their own seeds; every reading came back letter for letter. K4's and the copies' readings judged blind, one call per verdict.

K4 above every copy in 0 of 8 (chance 0.56). The judge found 20 of 20 planted running keys (quadgrams 11) but only 2 of 18 climbed free-alphabet plants: the climbed readings are about a third right, too little to read.
